nodes.text: Well now. A *new face* in Bramblewick — and the road still on your boots. Come here, let me look at you.
Mm. Bright eyes. Strong hands. The town could use both. I'm *Maren* — folk say Old Maren, and they're not wrong.
Go on then, ask. Everyone does.

Bramblewick. Quiet town, loud history. Farms to the west, a deep cave northeast, and that Riftgate humming away like it pays rent. The elders say this plaza was a battlefield once — that the well was dug to give the fallen something sweet to remember. I say the elders enjoy scaring the young. Still... _some nights the Riftgate hums a note nobody taught it_, and I keep my shutters latched. We manage.
Speak with *Captain Alda* at the north arch — tell her Maren sent you. She growls, but she keeps this town breathing. And keep bread in your pack; heroics run on crumbs.
Hello back, dear. It's been a while since anyone bothered. Here — you look hungry.
Take these — {item:bread}, fresh this morning, more or less. Now off with you — the world doesn't wait politely.
